Map in 2 sections mounted on cloth backing.

Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Map in 2 sections mounted on cloth backing. This incomplete map without title covers only the east portion showing in the map entitled "Carte particulière d'une partie de la Louisianne ... " by Demarigny. The map contains almost indentical text but without author's signature at end and slightly different forms of place names and features. Includes text.
